$comment: Image licence register and shot list (HANDOVER §1.5, §3.6). Every image shipped on the site has an entry here recording its source URL, photographer and licence. Entries with file: null are open slots: they describe what the page needs and double as the brief for the real photo shoot in MASTERPLAN §6.9.

rules.permittedSubjects: Place and atmosphere only: Turkish campuses, Istanbul and Ankara streets, architecture, textures, study desks, documents.
neverPermitted: A stock photo of a person presented as a Minaret student, staff member, or testimonial.
Images pulled from web search or Google Images.
Posed groups around a laptop, graduation cap throws, handshakes, white-background isolated people.
Unsplash+ / plus.unsplash.com premium photos. Those carry a paid licence, not the free Unsplash License.
rules.note: Images are downloaded and committed to public/images/ and served through next/image. The site CSP is img-src 'self' data: blob:, so a hotlinked remote image is blocked at the browser rather than merely discouraged.

images.subject: Istanbul skyline over the Bosphorus with mosques and minarets, at dusk. No identifiable people.
images.licence: Unsplash License, free for commercial use
images.verified: Downloaded and visually checked: place and atmosphere only, no people, no political or religious messaging in frame.
images.status: in use. Replace with a commissioned photograph when the real shoot happens.

images.subject: Ankara rooftops with a mosque and minaret, city beyond. No identifiable people.
images.licence: Unsplash License, free for commercial use
images.verified: Downloaded and visually checked: place and atmosphere only, no people.
images.status: in use. Replace with a photograph of the actual Ankara office when one exists.

images.subject: Istanbul street scene
images.status: REJECTED after visual check. Several identifiable people in the foreground, and a large political portrait on the building. Identifiable strangers risk being read as students, and political imagery has no place on a commercial education site.

images.brief: Document detail: a stamped transcript, an acceptance letter on a desk, shallow depth of field. This is the texture the registry direction wants. Note that the obvious Unsplash results for this subject are Unsplash+ premium and cannot be used.
images.status: open. The section currently uses the paper-grain texture instead.

images.brief: One campus or city photograph per university page. Architecture and grounds, not people.

The real Ankara office, interior and exterior with a visible street sign or building number. This one cannot be sourced from stock: it carries the 'we are actually in Türkiye' claim and must be a real photograph of the real premises.
Real placed students, named, with signed release. MASTERPLAN §6.9 shot list item 1.
images.status: open. Stock people are never permitted here under any circumstances. The cards render an explicit 'photograph pending consent' block instead.
